user.title: Family Panel
user.description: Adds the Family panel to the sidebar: school, agenda, meals, chores and screen time. The sources are found by integration; pick them in the options to choose them yourself.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Family Panel is already set up.

init.title: Family Panel sources
init.description: Pick the entities the panel shows. A list left empty is filled with the entities of the integrations made for it (Mealie, Bring, Donetick, Waste Collection Schedule…).
